jobs.title: Learning and Development Program Manager
jobs.description:
Restaurant365 is a SaaS company disrupting the restaurant industry! Our cloud-based platform provides a unique, centralized solution for accounting and back-office operations for restaurants. Restaurant365’s culture is focused on empowering team members to produce top-notch results while elevating their skills. We’re constantly evolving and improving to make sure we are and always will be “Best in Class” ... and we want that for you too!


About the Role 
R365's Talent Solutions team brings the full talent lifecycle together—connecting Talent Acquisition, Performance Management, Capabilities, and Learning & Development to attract exceptional people, build capability, accelerate performance, and help our people and business thrive. 
As Program Manager, Talent Programs, you will be responsible for the day-to-day execution of assigned Talent Programs, as a pivotal part of our AI-forward Talent Solutions team. You’ll bring start-to-finish program execution excellence to assigned talent programs and workstreams across Talent Acquisition, Performance Management, Capabilities, and Learning & Development. This is an opportunity to make a visible impact across the People Team as department and R365 as a whole. 
This role is ideal for individuals skilled at program coordination, delivery, stakeholder management, and driving meaningful outcomes, while also experimenting with ways to use AI and modern tools to improve outcomes, gain efficiencies, and improve programs in meaningful ways. The Program Manager, Talent Programs, serves as a trusted point of contact for program participation and internal and external stakeholders. Your attention to detail will directly impact the R365 employee experience. 
Some immediate programs might include annual performance management, career leveling, and new manager development. 
Travel is required 1 to 2 times per year with advance notice for team meetings at one of our offices: Irvine, CA, Akron, OH, or Austin, TX. This is a hybrid role requiring in-office presence on Tuesdays and Wednesdays for cross-functional collaboration. 

What You'll Do
Core Responsibilities

Program Execution

-
Manage learning and development and performance management programs from inception through close-out, including defined workstreams within larger initiatives, using established templates, tools, and processes.

-
Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned programs, ensuring a consistent experience for leaders, participants, and People team partners across cohorts and offerings.

-
Coordinate dependencies, track progress, and ensure on-time delivery across assigned programs and workstreams.

-
Prioritize tasks, stakeholder needs, and competing program demands to keep multiple initiatives on track and deliverables on time.

-
Close out assigned programs and workstreams in a documented and structured way, capturing lessons learned, final metrics, and handoff notes for future program cycles.

Stakeholder & Communication

-
Schedule and facilitate recurring program meetings, setting agendas, keeping discussions on track, and capturing decisions and action items.

-
Prepare status materials ahead of reviews using established templates and processes, ensuring stakeholders have current progress, risks, and open decisions in advance.

-
Track follow-through between meetings, flagging risks and communicating program impacts, risks, and updates to the Senior Manager before they escalate.

-
Build and maintain strong working relationships with People Business Partners, People Operations & Technology, Workforce Strategy, Total Rewards, subject matter experts, and vendors.

-
Navigate competing stakeholder priorities and escalate unresolved tensions or decisions to the Senior Manager with clear context and a recommended path forward.

Reporting & Insights

-
Maintain accurate and timely program reports, dashboards, and metrics including participation, completion, retention, and ROI against KPIs established by the Senior Manager.

-
Ensure program data is consistently defined and properly maintained before reporting, flagging gaps or inconsistencies to the Senior Manager.

-
Support the analysis of engagement, adoption, and effectiveness data to surface trends and insights.

-
Identify and surface improvement opportunities to the Senior Manager based on feedback, data, and program observations.

-
Other duties as defined
What you bring
Qualifications

-
Bachelor’s degree in human resources, organizational development, business administration, or a related field.

-
2+ years coordinating programs, projects, or operations in a fast-moving business function. Experience in Human resources is helpful.

-
Comfortable working remotely and managing work independently across a distributed and hybrid team in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment where priorities shift, and strong follow-through is essential.

-
Uses AI and emerging technology to improve how the work gets done. This includes building repeatable workflows, selecting the right tool for each task, and showing measurable gains in efficiency and quality.

-
Flexibility to take on an existing program or workstream at any point in the program process.

-
Strong organizational, relationship-building, project management, and collaboration skills with the ability to manage multiple programs at once.

-
Strong communication skills with the ability to convey complex program information clearly and concisely for a variety of audiences.

-
Applies systems thinking with a curiosity to understand how programs and workstreams connect and impact each other.

Preferred

-
Experience building learning and development content and presentations, and/or delivering it through live facilitation.

-
Professional experience in a prior industry or function that demonstrates strong organizational habits, accountability, and the ability to thrive in a structured, fast-paced environment.

Success Measures

-
Deliver assigned programs and workstreams on time and on budget.

-
Surface risks and escalate decisions to the Senior Manager with options and a recommendation, early enough to act on.

-
Meet or exceed satisfaction targets with stakeholders and participants, and hold strong participation, completion, and retention.

-
Maintain accurate, current program reporting and KPI tracking.

-
Build stronger systems thinking, judgment, and risk awareness over time.

These measures reflect ongoing, steady-state performance after ramp. In the first 90 days, success is measured incrementally through the structured 30/60/90 framework.

jobs.title: People Operations Generalist - Compliance & Benefits
jobs.description:
Restaurant365 is a SaaS company disrupting the restaurant industry! Our cloud-based platform provides a unique, centralized solution for accounting and back-office operations for restaurants. Restaurant365’s culture is focused on empowering team members to produce top-notch results while elevating their skills. Restaurant365 is adding a People Operations Generalist to the People Technology & Operations team to serve as the primary point of accountability for HR compliance and benefits administration across all operating countries. This is a hands-on, execution-focused role for someone who thrives at the intersection of employee experience, regulatory compliance, and benefits program ownership. 
The successful candidate will own the benefits relationship with our benefit partners (including Sequoia), drive compliance programs end-to-end, be the first responder on Total Rewards Fresh Service tickets and Received Mail queue management and deploy AI and automation to drive efficiency and reduce manual work.   
Following the expansion of People Technology & Operations to include Benefits Administration and HR Compliance, this hire closes a critical gap: owning the compliance and benefits function at the practitioner level. With open enrollment targeting early November and multi-country benefit programs in active management, the team needs a practitioner who can: 
Serve as the primary compliance owner — EEO-1, FMLA/LOA, state/local employment law, I-9, background checks, SOC2 HR controls 



How you'll add value: 
Compliance — Primary Owner

-
Own the end-to-end HR compliance calendar: EEO-1 reporting, FLSA audits, I-9 program, state/local posting requirements

-
Administer and manage LOA programs (FMLA, state PDL, parental leave, accommodations) in partnership with legal and HRIS

-
Maintain background check program and ensure compliant onboarding across all states and countries

-
Assist with SOC2 HR controls, internal audits, and HR risk assessments

-
Use AI to accelerate compliance drafting, monitoring, and documentation — reducing turnaround time and human error

Benefits Administration — Partner & Executor

-
Own   end ‑ to ‑ end  benefits administration , including eligibility, enrollments/life events, carrier file feeds, billing and premium reconciliation, open enrollment planning and execution, and employee issue resolution

-
Manage benefits vendors and broker/consultant relationships; support renewals, plan changes, and service ‑ level monitoring

-
Partner closely with Payroll to ensure accurate benefit deductions, arrears/retroactivity handling, audits, and resolution of pay ‑ impacting issues

-
Automate benefits data reconciliation and enrollment communications using workflow automation and AI drafting tools

Ticket Management

-
Triage, own, and resolve Total Rewards tickets and support People Ops ticket queue

-
Manage Received Mail queue — process and route correspondence, legal notices, garnishments, and government agency mail

-
Partner on onboarding and offboarding processes as a backup to the People Ops lead

-
Maintain accurate employee records in Workday; run compliance and benefits audit reports

-
Contribute to process documentation and SOPs for the team's compliance and benefits workflows

-
Build AI-powered triage and auto-response workflows to reduce ticket handle time and eliminate repeat volume
What you'll need to be successful in this role: 
-
5+ years   of progressive HR operations experience with significant hands ‑ on responsibility for HR Compliance and benefits administration

-
Strong working knowledge of benefits operations, including life events, carrier feeds, reconciliation, and vendor management

-
Experience partnering with Payroll on deductions, reconciliations, and pay ‑ impacting transactions

-
Demonstrated ownership of multi-state or multi-country benefits programs

-
Excellent communication skills and discretion when handling confidential information

-
Experience serving as the primary HR compliance resource for a company with  5 00+ employees

-
Experience leading open enrollment for  5 00+ employee populations

-
Working knowledge of FMLA, ADA, FLSA, EEO-1, I-9, COBRA, and state-level employment regulations

-
Comfortable identifying compliance gaps and drafting corrective policy without requiring a template

-
Proficiency in an enterprise HRIS — Workday strongly preferred

Differentiating Qualities (All Levels)

-
AI-forward mindset — actively looks for automation opportunities in repetitive HR workflows

-
Operates with urgency and follows through; treats open tickets and open compliance items as risks to close

-
Strong communicator who can translate compliance requirements into plain-language employee guidance

-
High EQ and discretion when handling sensitive employee matters

-
Comfortable working across time zones to serve a globally distributed workforce

Definition of Success — First 90 Days

-
Full audit of benefits data feeds between HRIS and benefit partners completed; discrepancies resolved

-
FreshService ticket SLAs met at ≥ 90% within 30 days of onboarding

-
Compliance calendar built and owned — EEO-1, state postings, LOA tracker, I-9 audit cycle

-
Sequoia relationship transitioned; open enrollment readiness confirmed with benefits partner

-
Received Mail workflow documented with clear handoffs and SLA targets
